tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inside inputs, segmented track, and the command block header. Barely lifts off paper; the border does the separating.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: log view, command body, hover fill on ghost buttons and segment options, disabled controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections, list rows and table rows. Decorative only, never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of containers people read but don't type into: secondary buttons, segmented track, command block.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Edges of things you type into or tick: text inputs, radios, switch track. 3.2:1 on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, primary button fill, selected segment fill, checked radio, focus ring. 18:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected segment on hover.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, labels of counters, placeholders, skipped log lines, unselected segments. 6.5:1 on paper, 6.0:1 on sunken.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Disabled text only. Never for text people need to read.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, selected segment).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind the lightbox only, with on-ink for its text and controls. A documented exception for looking at media, not a dark theme. 19:1 against on-ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: field error text and border, failed status, error log lines, Stop and Cancel text. 6.4:1 on paper, 5.9:1 on sunken. Always paired with a word or ✕.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waits and cautions: rate-limit countdown, layout-differs notice, queued-behind message, warning log lines. 5.8:1 on paper, 5.3:1 on sunken.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline, 2px solid with a 2px offset. Reads on every ground the system uses.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Form section headings and panel titles. Sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Uses the post date, not the download date.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints, status words, table secondary cells.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, file paths, handles, folder previews.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; label to its input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input side padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between fields in one section; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between form sections; column gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page to title; desktop side gutter is space-12 + space-8.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segment options, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented track, log view.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Command block and the run panel. Nothing rounder exists.

shadow.note: No elevation. Edges come from borders.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Menus and popovers use a line-strong border instead of a shadow.
